snippet.title: Infinitesimals - Reveal Trailer | Epic Games Publishing
snippet.description:
The characters may be small, but the stakes couldn't be bigger!

Join Capt. Awkney in his search for a new home for his people in Infinitesimals, from Cubit Studios.

Coming to PS5, Xbox Series and PC via the Epic Game Store in 2026: https://infinitesimals.game
